title: P: Add Rhys-only AI cap and reviewer manual checks
public_pr_body:
Update Rhys's existing N1–N6 checklist with plain click steps for #232's company-specific Tolra-provided AI cap, set by Rhys only. Covers A/B limits and modes, owner/MFA refusals, hidden keys, usage floor/maximum and near-limit contention; distinguishes the two-tab exercise from the real two-connection DB proof.

Add the reviewer conditions for #233 chase approval/edit/double-send/unknown delivery, #221/#230 accounting encryption/provider/company isolation, #222 own-admin progress policy, #223 old wording/read-only saving/exact reviewed text, and side-by-side paid/unpaid hours. Correct the inherited eight-hour unpaid example to 7h15 under its explicit 30+15-minute rule; preserve the requirement that timesheets and planned hours agree.

Based on #227's codex2/n1-n6-browser-checks, so this PR changes ONLY tests/MANUAL-CHECKS-N1-N6.md and does not pull the browser feature into main. All steps remain unticked; public evidence contains no keys or real customer records.

Validation: manual content/link review and git diff check passed. No code changes; unit/DB/browser checks not rerun for this checklist edit. No SQL applied, test data modified, deployment, Ready label or merge. Database/proposal/concurrency/provider checks stay open until their own runtime evidence exists.
